issues.description: Method calculateTotalPrice: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be static and to use the shared static stock (problem_statement.md lines 77-81). In the solution implementation SealSaloon.java the method is implemented as an instance method with signature 'public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)' (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 57). This static-vs-instance mismatch between the specification and the provided solution confuses the required method signature and how students should call/use the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the specification/implementation mismatch. Option A (preferred to match spec): Change the implementation signature to 'public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)' in SealSaloon.java and update any call sites to use SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal) or otherwise reference the static method. Ensure the method continues to use the shared static stock field. Option B: If the intended design is instance-based, update the problem statement to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice be static so the spec and implementation agree.
